title: Understanding Standardization
text: Standardization is a preprocessing step where we adjust the features of the training data to have a mean of $$0$$ and a variance of $$1$$. This is done to ensure that each feature contributes equally to the model's learning process.

title: Effect of Standardization on Overfitting
text: Overfitting occurs when a model learns the noise in the training data rather than the actual signal. Consider whether standardizing the training data would cause the model to learn noise instead of the underlying patterns.

title: Impact of Standardization on Cross-Validation
text: In k-fold cross-validation, the model is trained and validated on different subsets of the data. Standardizing the training data ensures that each fold is on the same scale, which helps in consistent model evaluation.
